        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.RSI_PERIOD,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders
        )

        self.spy_order_pending = False
        self.aapl_order_pending = False

            aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

            previous_spy_close <= previous_sma

        aapl_quantity = int(self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity)

            spy_quantity > 0

            and spy_crossed_below

                -spy_quantity,
                tag="Strategy A sell"

            spy_quantity == 0

                ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.aapl,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy B buy"
                )
                if ticket is not None:
                    self.aapl_order_pending = True

        if order_event.Symbol == self.spy:

        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.strategy_b_order_pending = False

            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:

                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:

            bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        )

            spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

            indicators_ready = (
                self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
            )

            if indicators_ready:
                current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < current_spy_sma
                )
                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > current_spy_sma
                )

                    self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                    and not self.strategy_a_order_pending
                    and spy_crosses_below
                ):
                    self.strategy_a_order_pending = True
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.spy,
                        -self.strategy_a_shares,
                        tag="Strategy A sell"
                    )

                if (
                    self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                    and not self.strategy_b_order_pending
                    and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
                ):
                    self.strategy_b_order_pending = True
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        -self.strategy_b_shares,
                        tag="Strategy B sell"
                    )

                if (
                    self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                    and not self.strategy_a_order_pending
                    and spy_crosses_above
                ):
                    quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.spy, 0.40)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.strategy_a_order_pending = True
                        self.MarketOrder(
                            self.spy,
                            quantity,
                            tag="Strategy A buy"
                        )

                if (
                    self.strategy_b_shares == 0
                    and not self.strategy_b_order_pending
                    and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                    and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
                ):
                    quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.strategy_b_order_pending = True
                        self.MarketOrder(
                            self.aapl,
                            quantity,
                            tag="Strategy B buy"
                        )

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            self.previous_aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)

        if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled]:
            fill_quantity = int(order_event.FillQuantity)

            if tag.startswith("Strategy A"):
                self.strategy_a_shares = max(
                    0,
                    self.strategy_a_shares + fill_quantity
                )
            elif tag.startswith("Strategy B"):
                self.strategy_b_shares = max(
                    0,
                    self.strategy_b_shares + fill_quantity
                )

        if order_event.Status in [
            OrderStatus.Filled,
            OrderStatus.Canceled,
            OrderStatus.Invalid
        ]:
            if tag.startswith("Strategy A"):
                self.strategy_a_order_pending = False
            elif tag.startswith("Strategy B"):
                self.strategy_b_order_pending = False
